Name: Giulia Viggiano
Bio: Giulia is a sophomore studying Chemical Engineering with a minor in Bioengineering and plans to pursue the Engineering Corporate Practice minor. Originally from New York City, she studied abroad in Rome, Italy through the ND Engineering summer program. On campus, Giulia is a Hypatia Scholar who lives in Grojean Hall, where she serves as a commissioner, and she is also involved with SWE. She previously served as the social media co-chair for the First-Year Engineering Council (FYEC) and is currently serving on ELC's social committee.

Name: Riley Carlin
Bio: Riley is a senior Electrical Engineering major serving as Corporate Committee Member for ELC this year.

Name: Ariana Castro
Bio: Ariana is a sophomore studying Electrical Engineering and has been involved with ELC through the FYEC Social Committee and now ELC Communications Committee, where she supports graphic design and engineering club outreach. She also serves as Media Lead for the Renewable Energy Club and Society of Women Engineers, as well as a Lead Ambassador for the Women’s Network. Outside the classroom, she enjoys playing volleyball and volunteering in the local South Bend community.
